purpose: Executable ledger for the `symmetry-anomaly-conservation` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Conservation-law and Ward-identity rows cap conservation language but do not by themselves establish quantum-gravity consistency, anomaly freedom, or candidate-native observability.

conservation_rows.conserved_quantity_or_ward_identity: boundary charge, modular/edge mode, and code-subspace Ward-identity budget
conservation_rows.conservation_or_ward_rule: Name the current, charge, flux, Ward identity, continuity equation, constraint, Bianchi identity, soft charge, catalog conservation law, or benchmark invariant; declare whether it is exact, anomalous, approximate, coarse-grained, dissipative, or merely a bookkeeping convention.
conservation_rows.violation_or_leakage_mode: Failure can appear as charge leakage into hidden sectors, anomalous nonconservation, boundary flux loss, detector/catalog selection masquerading as conservation, coarse-graining loss, frame-dependent conservation, or metadata counts mistaken for physical conserved quantities.
conservation_rows.conservation_test: Track the quantity through acquisition, gauge/quotient, boundary/sector, renormalization/matching, composition, information flow, and public record conversion; if the budget does not close, freeze conserved-current, Ward-identity, or charge language.
conservation_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer physical law, symmetry realization, no-global-symmetry compliance, anomaly cancellation, or candidate-native identity from conservation wording unless the conserved object and residual leakage are explicitly route-bound.
